context: Reference focused explicit review: supplier-taking APIs must keep expensive fallback work lazy.

checklist.name: Identifies eager remote work
checklist.description: Explains that both methods call remote.load before knowing whether a fallback or cache-miss value is needed, causing unnecessary slow calls and observable rate-limit side effects.

checklist.name: Keeps Optional fallback lazy
checklist.description: Recommends moving the remote.load call into orElseGet or an equivalent lazy branch so it runs only when the cache lookup is absent.

checklist.name: Keeps computeIfAbsent creation lazy
checklist.description: Recommends calling remote.load inside the computeIfAbsent mapping function, or an equivalent lazy miss-only branch, rather than precomputing the value.

checklist.name: Preserves contracts and focus
